description: This file defines the ConditionalTernary class within the Twig templating engine, representing a ternary conditional expression node in the abstract syntax tree. It includes methods for constructing, compiling, and escaping operands of the ternary expression.

classes.name: ConditionalTernary
classes.description: Represents a ternary conditional expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, with methods for compilation and operand escaping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ConditionalTernary node with test, true, and false expressions, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the ternary expression into PHP code.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the list of operand names ('left', 'right') that should be escaped.
